description.zh:
指定返回结果中管控策略描述的语言。取值：

- zh-CN（默认值）：中文。
- en：英文。
- ja：日文。

> 该参数仅在系统管控策略时有效。
description.en:
The language in which you want to return the description of the access control policy. Valid values:

*   zh-CN (default value): Chinese
*   en: English
*   ja: Japanese

>  This parameter is valid only for system access control policies.
The ID of the access control policy.

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，查询ID为`cp-SImPt8GCEwiq****`的管控策略详情。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to call the API operation to query the details of the access control policy whose ID is `cp-SImPt8GCEwiq****`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager get-control-policy --policy-id cp-SImPt8GCEwiq0000 --biz-language zh-CN --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
